description: This Java source file defines a helper class ResponseHelper responsible for creating and managing autofill datasets for inline fill service in Android. It includes methods to generate unlocked and locked datasets with various presentations and inline suggestions, tailored for autofill workflows.

classes.name: ResponseHelper
classes.description: A utility class to generate autofill datasets with different presentation modes and inline suggestions, both in locked and unlocked states.

methods.name: newUnlockedDataset
methods.description: Creates a new autofill dataset with inline and dropdown presentations, used when the dataset is unlocked.

methods.name: newLockedDataset
methods.description: Creates a new autofill dataset in a locked state, requiring user authentication, with inline and dropdown presentations.

methods.name: newDatasetPresentation
methods.description: Helper method to generate a RemoteViews presentation with specified text.
